about_the_game:
Reduced price due to initial release being flat-screen only, single player and sand-box. 

A digital toy God sand-box inspired by the love of great God Games of the past with the fascination of an ant farm . Running on a purpose built unique engine allowing full environmental planetary terraforming, with 10s of 1000s of inhabitants all reacting in-real-time, even from planetary orbit

Starting out as a fledgling god, known as the Igigu, trying to impress the Anunnaki (your creators), you are responsible for creating and raising the Sumer, a race of primitive, but hard working (sometimes!), creatures on a new planetary body created by the Anunnaki.

From kickstarting their creation to dipping them in the sea when they 'occasionally' catch fire, their entire survival is in your hands.

Using the powers bestowed upon you by the Anunnaki, help terraform the landscape to create land that's close enough to water for the Sumer to drink and feed as well as stable and level enough for them to build. Encourage the growth of trees/grass by controlling the elements such as the water and the sun. Protect the Sumer from other inhabitants and natural, or unnatural, disasters.

In return for your care the Sumer’s belief and love (or fear) will furnish you with mana, the source of your power. As your mana grows, so do your powers and abilities, from throwing simple fire bolts to summoning mighty guardians, the power is quite literally in your hands.
